title: Delicious in Dungeon
description: Dungeons, dragons… and delicious monster stew!? Adventurers foray into a cursed buried kingdom to save their friend, cooking up a storm along the way.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After a crushing loss, Laios, Marcille, and Chilchuck quickly reenter the dungeon to save Falin, but this time, they have a foolproof survival plan.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Laios and crew access a hidden area guarded by mysterious Living Armor, who appear to be protecting something potentially delicious.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: As another group of adventurers discovers a treasure box, a swarm of bone-chilling ghosts chases Laios and his crew. Senshi, however, has a sweet plan.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: A starving Laios angers a mysterious elf while hunting for food in Living Paintings. Later, Chilchuck finds himself trapped with a crabby Mimic.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Marcille recalls when she first met Falin as young students. After a quick wash up, an inadvertent misstep lands her in deep water with an angry spirit.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The smell of meat lures in uninvited guests — among them, a familiar face emerges. To move forward, they must work together to defeat the Undine.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The crew avoid a stinging descent to the castle town, where the Red Dragon lurks. But to defeat it, they need a tight plan — and a morale-boosting meal.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The crew finally faces the Red Dragon, but their grand strategy quickly unravels. With the beast's fury escalating, who will get the final bite?

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: A desperate search within the dragon's stomach leads to a gruesome discovery, revealing that resurrection magic alone won't be enough to restore Falin.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Falin starts acting strange in the middle of the night, leading Laios and crew to a menacing figure who wants them gone.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Trapped in the dungeon, a concerned Senshi cooks up a nourishing meal for the famished crew — giving Marcille enough energy to come up with a plan.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: The crew is cornered by an acquaintance who demands help with a beastly problem. Later, Laios enters Marcille's nightmare and discovers her greatest fear.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: With the dungeon's fate hanging in the balance, Kabru negotiates with the elves. Meanwhile, a ghost drags Laios and crew into the cursed Golden Country.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Back at camp, Senshi finally reveals his painful history with the dungeon. The next day, the crew is rudely awakened by a perplexing transformation.

episodes_data.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Still wrestling with their new forms, the crew must overcome the gargoyles. Later, they descend deeper into the dungeon. What monsters will they try next?
